{
  "thinking": "Leo has taken on the fin fix I suggested, and the tail spurs and flatter nose split look workable. Sofia holds the pad and is the one to redraw, so I'll back that and keep my hands off the dominoes while the sketch changes.",
  "say": "Sounds good, Leo. Each fin as its own spur off the body edge, ahead of the tip, and the flatter first stretch on the nose split. Sofia, once you've redrawn those, I'll stay off the start until stroke one is down and check the knock-on before the push.",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 4,
  "point": [5, 10],
  "do": "stop",
  "notes": "Pad map: stroke 1 = short nose stub, START at right end, Tom laying it now. Stroke 2 = top edge, nose to top tail tip. Stroke 3 = bottom edge, nose to bottom tail tip (Omar's plan). Stroke 4 = tail fork, top tip to middle to bottom tip. Agreed fix (Hana, Tom, Leo): fins become separate spurs branching off the body edges a little ahead of the tips, nothing joining back at the notch; nose split first stretches flattened closer to straight back. Waiting on Sofia to redraw strokes 2-4 before anyone traces stroke 2. Eye is a label only. Before the push: check the start's knock-on (it currently reaches about 12 standing dominoes near the start) and make sure stroke 1 is connected through to the nose split."
